name: Bloodbond Bladesworn: [Class Bonus] +1 POWER per 10 damage counters on champion
notes: Same technique as steel-halberd-class-bonus-power / shuang-ji-sacrifice-champion-damage-power: [Class Bonus] scans all physical field objects (a physically-seeded WARRIOR champion, Jin, Fate Defiant, satisfies it independent of the main champion), and the damage-scaling bonus reads the real champion's Damage property directly (GameLogic.php ~11514-11524, ZoneSearch for the CHAMPION then intdiv($champObj->Damage, 10)). Champion Damage patched to 25: base POWER 3 + intdiv(25, 10) = 3 + 2 = 5. This card's other ability ('When dealt damage, deal the same amount to your champion', dealDamageAbilities['blyb6fd6vy:0']) requires a real combat/damage-dealing event and is out of scope here.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] This ally gets +1 POWER for every 10 damage counters on your champion.
